groups.name: Nature recovering
groups.statement: By 2030 the decline in biodiversity is halted; effective regulation, habitat restoration and nature-based solutions contribute to increasingly resilient ecosystems enabling adaptation to change, benefiting people's well-being.

groups.name: Climate action and adaptation
groups.statement: By 2030 sustained action on the causes, risks and impacts of climate change means nature and people are enabled and empowered to adapt, alleviating the effects on people's well-being.

groups.name: Pollution minimised
groups.statement: By 2030 pollution is minimised through effective regulation and legislative reform, reducing harm to biodiversity and people's well-being, and driving the sustainable management and use of natural resources.

groups.name: Social and environmental justice
groups.statement: By 2030 increased action for social and environmental justice is maximising benefits for nature, climate, and pollution and reducing social inequalities.

groups.name: Collaborative action
groups.statement: By 2030 sustained collaborative action means individuals and organisations are taking integrated decisions to address the nature, climate and pollution emergencies.

groups.name: NRW values and behaviours
groups.statement: By 2030 consistent delivery of our values and behaviours in NRW mean colleagues, partners and communities are engaged, enabled and empowered to innovate and accelerate action.

groups.name: Nature is Recovering
groups.note: Also contributing: SI7, SI9, SI10 and SI11, through connecting people with nature, partnership and action.

groups.name: Communities are Resilient to Climate Change
groups.note: Also contributing: SI2, through nature-based solutions.

name: NRW corporate plan performance framework

metric_sources: SoNaRR / SoNaRR2020 resilience assessments (DECCA framework; update published 2025)
requirements.name: Increasing the proportion of ecosystems that are defined as resilient
requirements.scanability_note: Drivers are external (targets, legislation, plans) even though the SoNaRR resilience assessment itself is NRW's.

metric_sources: Protected sites metric (revamped)
Evaluated project outcomes (LIFE, Natur am Byth)
requirements.name: Increasing the rate of habitat restoration
requirements.scanability_note: Restoration rate data is largely NRW's and partners'; external scanning sees the funding and policy drivers, not the rate.

metric_sources: Public bodies' Environment (Wales) Act Section 6 reporting
PSB well-being plans and Nature Charters
WFGA journey to a resilient Wales
requirements.name: Increasing the integration of activities that support nature recovery into Wales' public services
requirements.scanability_note: Section 6 reporting, PSB well-being plans and public body strategies are all published externally.

metric_sources: Water Framework Directive elements at most recent analysis
WIRS incident data and case studies
Land pollution element (forthcoming)
requirements.name: Decreasing the rate of pollution on land and entering water bodies
requirements.scanability_note: WFD classification, regulations and water governance are external and well covered.

metric_sources: Air quality standards and objectives (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2)
Critical levels and loads for protected sites (NH3, N deposition)
Clean Air (Wales) target setting via Clean Air Advisory Panel
requirements.name: Decreasing the rate of pollution to air from industrial and non-industrial sources
requirements.scanability_note: Air quality legislation, targets and standards are external and well covered.

metric_sources: UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory statistics (Welsh reporting)
Internal data on woodland regeneration and restocking
NPAP outcomes and seagrass restoration
requirements.name: Decreasing the rate of greenhouse gas emissions and increasing the rate of sustainable sequestration
requirements.scanability_note: Carbon budgets and the UK GHG Inventory are external and published on a known cycle.

metric_sources: Wales Green Infrastructure Data Set
Green Flag / Green Flag Community Award boundaries (Keep Wales Tidy, annual)
NRW Greenspace Toolkit standards
National social surveys (perceptions, distance, use, behaviours)
requirements.name: Increasing the proportion of the population who have access to high quality green or blue space, and who use them sustainably
requirements.scanability_note: Green Flag and the GI data set are external but published annually; policy drivers are visible, use and access data less so.
requirements.short: Access to green and blue space

metric_sources: NRW flood maps and capital programme data
SUDS Approving Boards data
Planning system data and UGI case studies
Social survey data on perceived flood risk and well-being
Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation
requirements.name: Increasing the proportion of the population living in places that will continue to support and contribute to their health and well-being in a changing climate
requirements.scanability_note: Flood policy, SUDS, planning and WIMD are external; NRW's own flood data is not.
requirements.short: Places resilient to a changing climate

metric_sources: Grants programme and partnership funding data and case studies
Area Statement impacts
PSB impacts
Strategic MoU improvements
Natur a Ni and Citizens' Assemblies qualitative data
requirements.name: Increasing the impact of partnership approaches which deliver multiple benefits and address the root causes of the nature, climate and pollution crises
requirements.scanability_note: Evidence is mostly internal to NRW (grants, Area Statements, MoUs, Natur a Ni), but PSB well-being assessments and plans are published on a roughly 5-year cycle: the next assessments are due end 2026 to early 2027. So this is quiet between cycles with a known upcoming window, not permanently blind.

metric_sources: People and Nature Survey Wales (PaNS)
National Survey for Wales (pro-environmental actions, flood preparedness)
requirements.name: Increasing the proportion of the population that act to mitigate and adapt to the nature, climate and pollution crises
requirements.scanability_note: PaNS Wales and the National Survey are external but only speak at release; between releases this indicator is genuinely quiet.

metric_sources: Case studies from PSBs
Case studies from partnerships with industry
requirements.name: Increasing the proportion of organisations and businesses who act to mitigate and adapt to the nature, climate and pollution crises
requirements.scanability_note: Business and organisational action is largely qualitative case-study evidence, much of it internal. PSB and partnership plans publishing 2027 to 2028 are the main external window; between them expect little, so absence is weak evidence rather than a finding.

metric_sources: Ein Llais staff survey
requirements.name: Increasing the proportion of NRW colleagues feeling engaged, enabled and empowered
requirements.scanability_note: Internal staff survey (Ein Llais). No external source will ever report on it.
